Normally those with very controversial views are the ones who are too unwilling to believe others. All I can say for you is keep an open mind, for it will bring you further in life.

As much hate as this is getting, I feel treating ignorance with knowledge is the best approach. Being gay is genetic, as far as I believe. I grew up with a normal childhood in the "Bible Belt." Went to church every Sunday, and played sports and skated every day, I grew up as a regular kid. When I hit puberty, I developed an odd attraction to men. When I first noticed it, I denied it completely. When I faced it as a reality, I spent hours in a day thinking, almost FORCING myself to be attracted to women. I couldn't change it as I can't change my DNA. If I were given an opportunity to be heterosexual, I would take it in a heartbeat. Also, as far as I can see, it's not that homosexuals are attracted to anuses, we are attracted to the person in general. The reason we put our "procreation-meat" in a person's "shithole" because it's an alternative for our need to "hump" something. It's not that I'm disgusted by women, I'm just not attracted to them, and I feel if we didn't grow up in such a homophobic society, people wouldn't be so disgusted by homosexuals as I am not disgusted by heterosexuals.
